items.q: Our class ______ shows that we have PE right after lunch on Mondays.
items.vi: Thời khóa biểu của lớp mình cho thấy thứ Hai có tiết Thể dục ngay sau giờ ăn trưa.
items.explanation: Word choice: the thing that shows we have PE right after lunch on Mondays is the list of lesson times, so timetable fits. ✗ register — a list of names used to record who is present; ✗ diary — a personal book where you write your own plans or thoughts; ✗ agenda — the list of points to discuss at a meeting.

items.q: Lan ______ most of her pocket money on comic books and film magazines.
items.vi: Lan tiêu phần lớn tiền tiêu vặt vào truyện tranh và tạp chí điện ảnh.
items.explanation: Collocation: the pattern is spend money on something, and the clue is her pocket money on comic books. ✗ pays — you pay for something, not pay money on it; ✗ costs — the thing bought is the subject (comics cost money), not the person; ✗ uses — use money on is not a natural collocation for buying.

items.q: By next Friday, Lan ______ all her exam revision, so she can join the camping trip.
items.vi: Đến thứ Sáu tuần sau, Lan sẽ ôn thi xong hết nên có thể tham gia chuyến cắm trại.
items.explanation: Future perfect: by next Friday marks a deadline before which the action will be complete, so we need will have finished. ✗ will finish — future simple only says it happens some time in the future, not that it is done before the deadline; ✗ finishes — present simple cannot describe a future deadline here; ✗ has finished — present perfect is for something already done now, not by a future time.

items.q: The new coach is strict: any player who refuses to ______ will be dropped from the team.
items.vi: Huấn luyện viên mới rất nghiêm: cầu thủ nào không chịu tuân thủ kỷ luật sẽ bị loại khỏi đội.
items.explanation: Idiom: a strict coach drops players who refuse to obey, so toe the line (= obey the rules) fits. ✗ cross the line — go too far, behave unacceptably; ✗ draw the line — set a limit on what you will accept; ✗ hold the line — keep your position or refuse to change.

items.q: The doctor told Nam to ______ sweets and fizzy drinks before the big race.
items.vi: Bác sĩ bảo Nam giảm bớt kẹo và nước ngọt có ga trước cuộc đua lớn.
items.explanation: Phrasal verb: a doctor wants Nam to eat fewer sweets, so cut down on (= reduce the amount of) fits sweets and fizzy drinks. ✗ cut off — disconnect or remove completely; ✗ cut up — chop into pieces; ✗ cut across — take a short way through a place.

items.q: Lan got full ______ in the music quiz because she knew every song.
items.vi: Lan được điểm tối đa trong cuộc thi đố vui âm nhạc vì bạn ấy biết hết mọi bài hát.
items.explanation: Word choice: full marks is the fixed phrase for the highest possible score, and knew every song in a quiz confirms it. ✗ grades — letters like A or B for a course, not a quiz score; ✗ degrees — university qualifications, or units of temperature; ✗ levels — stages of difficulty, not a score.

items.q: Nam ______ have bought the concert tickets yet — the box office doesn't open until ten.
items.vi: Nam không thể nào đã mua vé buổi hòa nhạc được — quầy vé mười giờ mới mở cửa mà.
items.explanation: Modal of deduction: can't have + past participle says a past action was impossible, and the clue is the box office doesn't open until ten. ✗ mustn't — mustn't have is not used for deduction (we say can't have); ✗ needn't — needn't have means he did it but it wasn't necessary; ✗ shouldn't — shouldn't have criticises something he actually did.

items.q: Nam ______ two goals in the final, so his team won the school cup.
items.vi: Nam ghi hai bàn trong trận chung kết nên đội của cậu ấy giành cúp của trường.
items.explanation: Collocation: in football you score a goal, and the clue is two goals in the final. ✗ made — make a goal is not the football collocation; ✗ hit — you hit a ball or the post, not a goal; ✗ won — you win a match or a cup, not a goal.

items.q: Nam told his mother everything ______ had happened at the football match.
items.vi: Nam kể cho mẹ nghe mọi chuyện đã xảy ra ở trận bóng đá.
items.explanation: Relative pronoun: after everything (also all, nothing, superlatives) the relative pronoun is that. ✗ what — means 'the thing which' and cannot follow a noun like everything; ✗ who — refers to people, not things; ✗ which — not used after everything / all / nothing.

items.q: Lan has to ______ two chapters of history tonight, so she can't come to the cinema.
items.vi: Tối nay Lan phải ôn lại hai chương lịch sử nên không đi xem phim được.
items.explanation: Word choice: studying two chapters of history again before a test is to revise. ✗ rehearse — practise a play or performance; ✗ remind — make a person remember, so it needs a person as its object; ✗ repeat — say or do something again, not study it.

items.q: There were very ______ people at the early screening, so we got the best seats.
items.vi: Có rất ít người ở suất chiếu sớm nên bọn mình được ngồi chỗ đẹp nhất.
items.explanation: Quantifiers: people is countable and very makes the amount negative ('almost none'), so few fits. ✗ little — used with uncountable nouns; ✗ a few — positive ('some') and cannot follow very; ✗ a little — uncountable and cannot follow very.

items.q: Since Nam started spending every evening at the game arcade, he ______ in maths.
items.vi: Từ khi Nam bắt đầu tối nào cũng ở tiệm game, cậu ấy đã bị tụt lại môn toán.
items.explanation: Present perfect: since + past starting point describes a situation that began then and continues now, so we use has fallen behind. ✗ falls behind — present simple is for habits, not a change since a point in the past; ✗ fell behind — past simple would cut the link to now that since creates; ✗ had fallen behind — past perfect needs a later past event to be earlier than.

items.q: Nam remembers ______ his wallet on the shop counter, but now it isn't there.
items.vi: Nam nhớ là đã để ví trên quầy cửa hàng, nhưng giờ nó không còn ở đó nữa.
items.explanation: Gerund vs infinitive: remember + -ing is a memory of something already done, and the clue now it isn't there shows he is recalling leaving it. ✗ to leave — remember to do means not forgetting a future task; ✗ leave — remember is not followed by a bare infinitive; ✗ left — a past form cannot follow remember without that he had.

items.q: I didn't want to go to the concert, but Lan ______ and I ended up buying a ticket.
items.vi: Tôi không muốn đi xem hòa nhạc, nhưng Lan cứ nài ép nên cuối cùng tôi cũng mua vé.
items.explanation: Idiom: I didn't want to go but ended up buying a ticket, so Lan persuaded me against my will: twisted my arm. ✗ pulled my leg — joked with me, teased me; ✗ caught my eye — attracted my attention; ✗ held my hand — supported me closely through something.

items.q: Set your alarm tonight; ______, you will miss the early bus to the museum.
items.vi: Tối nay nhớ đặt báo thức, nếu không bạn sẽ lỡ chuyến xe buýt sớm đi bảo tàng.
items.explanation: Linking word: otherwise means 'if you don't do that', so no alarm → you will miss the bus. ✗ therefore — shows a result of the first sentence, but missing the bus is not the result of setting an alarm; ✗ besides — adds an extra point, not a warning; ✗ although — introduces a contrast clause and cannot stand after a semicolon and comma.

items.q: The school ______ ends next week, so the swimming pool will be full of students.
items.vi: Học kỳ sắp kết thúc vào tuần tới nên bể bơi sẽ đầy học sinh.
items.explanation: Word choice: the part of the school year that ends next week before a holiday is the term. ✗ period — one lesson slot in the timetable, under an hour; ✗ break — the short rest between lessons; ✗ lesson — a single class, not a part of the year.

items.q: The bookshop has ______ plastic bags, so remember to bring your own.
items.vi: Hiệu sách đã bỏ hẳn túi ni lông, nên nhớ mang túi của mình theo.
items.explanation: Phrasal verb: the shop has stopped using plastic bags, so remember to bring your own; do away with = get rid of, abolish. ✗ done up — fasten, or repair and decorate; ✗ done without — manage without something (the shop is not managing without bags, it has removed them); ✗ done in — exhaust or tire someone out.

items.q: If I ______ more pocket money, I would buy that second-hand guitar.
items.vi: Nếu tôi có nhiều tiền tiêu vặt hơn, tôi sẽ mua cây đàn ghi-ta cũ đó.
items.explanation: Second conditional: would buy in the main clause signals an unreal present, so the if-clause takes past simple had. ✗ have — present simple makes a first conditional, which needs will buy; ✗ would have — would does not go in the if-clause; ✗ have had — present perfect is not used in conditional if-clauses of this type.

items.q: Lan ______ chess with her grandfather every Sunday afternoon.
items.vi: Chiều Chủ nhật nào Lan cũng chơi cờ vua với ông.
items.explanation: Collocation: games with rules and a winner take play: play chess. ✗ does — do goes with activities like homework, yoga or karate; ✗ goes — go goes with -ing sports like swimming or cycling; ✗ makes — make does not collocate with games.

items.q: Either Nam or his sister ______ going to buy the tickets this afternoon.
items.vi: Hoặc Nam hoặc chị của cậu ấy sẽ đi mua vé chiều nay.
items.explanation: Subject–verb agreement: with either… or the verb agrees with the nearer subject, his sister (singular), so is. ✗ are — plural, but either… or does not add the subjects together; ✗ am — only for I; ✗ be — a bare infinitive cannot be the main verb of the sentence.

items.q: The novel ______ by our English teacher turned out to be much funnier than I expected.
items.vi: Cuốn tiểu thuyết được cô giáo tiếng Anh giới thiệu hóa ra vui hơn tôi tưởng nhiều.
items.explanation: Reduced relative clause: the novel (which was) recommended by our English teacher is passive, so the past participle recommended fits; by is the clue. ✗ recommending — active, would mean the novel itself recommends something; ✗ to recommend — an infinitive here would mean 'to be recommended in the future'; ✗ recommend — a bare verb cannot follow a noun as a modifier.

items.q: Nam can't go to football practice tonight because he has too much ______ to finish.
items.vi: Tối nay Nam không đi tập bóng đá được vì có quá nhiều bài tập về nhà phải làm.
items.explanation: Word choice: school work Nam must finish tonight at home is homework. ✗ classwork — work done during lessons in class; ✗ housework — cleaning, washing and cooking at home; ✗ paperwork — office forms and documents.

items.q: Nam and Lan often lend ______ their favourite comic books.
items.vi: Nam và Lan thường cho nhau mượn những cuốn truyện tranh yêu thích.
items.explanation: Reciprocal pronoun: Nam and Lan lend to one another, so each other. ✗ themselves — reflexive, would mean each lends to himself or herself; ✗ ourselves — refers to we, not the third-person subject; ✗ yourselves — refers to you, not Nam and Lan.

items.q: Let's watch the new animated film on Saturday, ______?
items.vi: Thứ Bảy mình đi xem bộ phim hoạt hình mới nhé?
items.explanation: Question tag: a suggestion with Let's always takes shall we. ✗ will we — will you is the tag for an imperative, and will we fits no pattern; ✗ do we — tags a present simple statement, and Let's is not a statement; ✗ don't we — the same, and positive statements take negative tags anyway.

items.q: Nam ______ a comic book in bed when the lights suddenly went out.
items.vi: Nam đang đọc truyện tranh trên giường thì đèn bỗng nhiên tắt.
items.explanation: Past continuous: a longer action in progress (was reading) is interrupted by a short past action, the lights suddenly went out. ✗ has read — present perfect cannot combine with a finished past event marked by when; ✗ reads — present simple is for habits, not a scene in the past; ✗ has been reading — present perfect continuous links to now, but the story is in the past.
